additional_info.body:
Dear Team,
Kindly refer the below steps to troubleshoot the error.
Check, if right ports are used to connect COR A10 to OPM-C60.
Check cable connection between Processing Unit and Card Reader.
Re-connect cables and re-start charger.
Exchange COR A10.
And please carry the spare of COR A10 and ethernet cable in case of replacement is needed
Spare parts-:
8EM5903-0AA02-7AA1
We thank you for your time and patience in advance.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -
Abhinav Malokar
